title: One-off convergence coverlist (ad-hoc tracker)
content:
Purpose: lightweight, one-page tracker for short-lived cross-team cleanup and low-effort cost/latency wins. Use to sync during the 2-week convergence window and then either snapshot + archive or promote to product-ops epic.

Notes on usage: informal, row owners are accountable for next-step by the date in the row. If no owner, tag an SE/PM and mark blocked. This is intentionally minimal — no full rollout plan here.

Snapshot metrics (quick back-of-envelope as of 2027-11-01):
- Estimated endpoints touched: 13
- Approx daily rps across impacted routes: 1.2k
- Rough monthly token throughput (impacted): ~450M tokens
- Baseline cost estimate for impacted traffic: ~$9.0k / month (vendor equivalent pricing used for heuristic)
- Target quick-win uplift (tokens saved / routing efficiency): 10–25% per item depending on approach

Ad-hoc coverlist table (columns: Item | Owner | Impact est | Effort | Blockers | Status | Next step + due)
1) Trim long-tail prompt prefixes on "search-summarize" route | Maya Chen | est 5–12% token trimming (~20–54M/mo) | Effort: 1 day dev + 1/2 day QA | blocker: l10n validation for JP/DE | status: in_work | next: Maya to open PR and add i18n test -> due 2027-11-05
2) Route low-priority queries to cheaper quantized variant (v2-q4) | Aaron Patel | est cost drop 18–30% (~1.6–2.7k/mo) | Effort: 2 days infra config | blocker: canary metric gap on latency p95 | status: blocked_by_obs | next: Aaron to add p95 probe to canary dashboard -> due 2027-11-04
3) Short-circuit identical prompt caching for /batch-embeds | Lina López | est token save N/A (reduces calls) -> op cost cut est $0.9k/mo | Effort: 3 days + migration | blocker: unknown cache TTL interactions | status: proposed | next: Lina to draft memcache TTL proposal and run smoke test -> due 2027-11-06
4) Lower default max_tokens for developer sandbox tier | Ethan Browne | est 7% token reduction across sandbox (low-dollar impact) | Effort: 2 hours config | blocker: docs and customer comm | status: done | next: update docs + notify community -> done 2027-11-02
5) Remove duplicate pre-processing step for "qa-demux" | Asha Menon | est latency p50 -10ms, tokens no-change | Effort: 1 day | blocker: none | status: in_review | next: Asha to merge refactor PR -> due 2027-11-03
6) Backfill missing routing rules for EU region (avoids cross-region failover) | Maya Chen | est latency reduction for EU requests p95 -120ms | Effort: 1.5 days infra + config | blocker: service account perms for infra-runbook | status: in_progress | next: Maya to coordinate with infra -> due 2027-11-07
7) Short-lived throttle for spike-burst 3rd-party partner | Aaron Patel | est prevents surge overage (~$0.6k/mo avoided) | Effort: 4 hours | blocker: partner SLAs confirmation | status: pending_partner | next: Aaron -> legal + partner call scheduled 2027-11-04
8) Lightweight prompt eval set check for top-10 customer queries | Lina López | est quality guard, prevents regressing on pruning work | Effort: 1 day | blocker: dataset curation | status: proposed | next: Lina to collect top queries and upload to eval harness -> due 2027-11-05

Quick-calcs / rationale: used simple rules-of-thumb for token cost: $0.00002 per input token equivalent when amortized; primary impact numbers are conservative and meant for prioritization only.

Decisions from 2027-11-01 sync (notes):
- Prioritize items 1,2,3 (Maya/Aaron/Lina) as they are small effort but compound across clients.
- Sandbox token cap change (item 4) is low friction and already applied.
- If item 2's p95 canary fails, fallback plan: route a slice of traffic to v2-cpu-quantized instead of full rollout.

Open questions / unknowns:
- Exact token-price equivalence for our internal cost model vs vendor benchmark. Ops-fin to follow up (linked ENG-1287).
- Impact of prompt-prefix trimming on customer-facing output quality; need 20-sample human spot-check for top 5 customers.

Action owners (short list):
- Maya Chen: PRs for item1 + EU routing changes (due 2027-11-05 / 2027-11-07)
- Aaron Patel: Canary probe + partner throttle coordination (due 2027-11-04)
- Lina López: cache TTL proposal + eval set upload (due 2027-11-06 / 2027-11-05)
- Asha Menon: merge refactor PR + wrap-up snapshot (due 2027-11-03 / 2027-11-12)

Archival plan: snapshot current sheet on 2027-11-15. If >2 items still active, convert to a product-ops epic and attach this tracker. Otherwise, mark as archived and append short postmortem line item to Confluence page.

Quick log (edits):
- 2027-11-01 Asha created initial table and estimates
- 2027-11-02 Ethan applied sandbox change and noted as done
- 2027-11-03 Asha updated statuses after code review

Random notes / breadcrumbs (links, quick refs):
- Slack thread: #ops-ad-hoc (search "convergence coverlist")
- Local test commands (dev-only): curl -H 'X-Test:1' https://api.redwood.internal/route?sample=1

If you pick up a row, please add a 1–2 line comment in the row describing the small validation you'll run (smoke metric, 20-user spot-check, or perf run). This keeps the tracker useful without requiring heavy process.

(End of sheet)
